question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The assumption that all data must be normalized (1)/ before processing it using machine learning algorithms (2)/ has been a common practice (3)/ in this domain for decades. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. before processing it using machine learning algorithms .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part **'2'**, which states: *"before processing it using machine learning algorithms."*
 
• The pronoun **"it"** is used incorrectly because it refers to "all data," which is plural. The correct pronoun to use is **"them."**
 
• The corrected sentence should read: *"before processing them using machine learning algorithms."*

Correct sentence: *The assumption that all data must be normalized before processing **them** using machine learning algorithms has been a common practice in this domain for decades*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Pronoun Errors:**

 
 
• Ensure that pronouns agree in number with their antecedents.
 
• Example: **Incorrect:** "The team lost their match." **Correct:** "The team lost its match."
 
 
 
• **Tips for Error Identification:**
 
 
• Look for subject-verb or pronoun-antecedent agreement issues.
 
• Check for misplaced or incorrect pronouns in complex sentences.
